questions.stem: A sum amounts to Rs. \(1350\) in \(5\) years and to Rs. \(1620\) in \(8\) years at simple interest. Find the principal amount.
questions.keySolution:
Difference in amount for \(3\) years = \(1620-1350 = 270\).  
Simple interest per year = \(270/3 = 90\).  
Simple interest for \(5\) years = \(90 \times 5 = 450\).  
Principal = \(1350 - 450 = 900\).

questions.stem: A certain sum at simple interest amounts to Rs. \(815\) in \(3\) years and to Rs. \(854\) in \(4\) years. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.keySolution:
Interest for the 4th year = \(854 - 815 = 39\).  
Simple interest for \(3\) years = \(39 \times 3 = 117\).  
Principal = \(815 - 117 = 698\).  
Rate = \(\frac{39 \times 100}{698} = 5.6\%\).

questions.stem: A sum of money invested at simple interest amounts to Rs. \(5000\) in \(5\) years and to Rs. \(5400\) in \(7\) years. Find the time in which it will amount to Rs. \(6200\).
questions.keySolution:
Interest for \(2\) years = \(5400-5000 = 400\).  
Interest per year = \(200\).  
Principal = \(5000 - (200 \times 5) = 4000\).  
Interest needed to reach \(6200\) = \(6200 - 4000 = 2200\).  
Time = \(2200/200 = 11\) years.

questions.stem: A principal becomes Rs. \(14522\) in \(7\) years and Rs. \(18906\) in \(11\) years at simple interest. What is the principal amount?
questions.keySolution:
Interest for \(4\) years = \(18906 - 14522 = 4384\).  
Interest per year = \(4384/4 = 1096\).  
Principal = \(14522 - 1096 \times 7 = 6850\).

questions.stem: The simple interest on a sum for \(4\) years is \(\frac{1}{5}\) of the principal. What is the rate of interest per annum?
A sum of Rs. \(25000\) becomes Rs. \(31000\) in \(4\) years at simple interest. Find the rate of interest per annum.
A man lends a sum at simple interest. The sum amounts to Rs. \(1365\) in \(2\) years and Rs. \(1950\) in \(5\) years. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.keySolution:
Interest for \(3\) years = \(1950-1365 = 585\).  
Interest per year = \(195\).  
Principal = \(1365 - (195 \times 2) = 975\).  
Rate = \(\frac{195 \times 100}{975} = 20\%\).

questions.stem: A sum amounts to Rs. \(10650\) in \(5\) years and Rs. \(11076\) in \(6\) years at simple interest. Find the principal.
questions.keySolution:
Interest for 1 year = \(11076-10650 = 426\).  
Interest for \(5\) years = \(426 \times 5 = 2130\).  
Principal = \(10650 - 2130 = 8520\).

questions.stem: At what rate percent per annum will a sum double itself in \(12\) years at simple interest?
questions.keySolution:
SI required = Principal (to double).  
\(P = \frac{P \times R \times 12}{100}\) \(\Rightarrow R = 8.33\%\).

questions.stem: A sum of money becomes \(\frac{8}{5}\) times itself in \(10\) years at simple interest. In how many years will it become double?
questions.keySolution:
From \(\frac{8}{5}\) times: SI for \(10\) years = \(0.6P\) ⇒ Rate = \(6\%\).  
To double (SI = \(P\)): \(T = 100/6 = 16\frac{2}{3}\) years.

If a sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs. \(3050\) in \(4\) years and Rs. \(3500\) in \(7\) years, find the principal.
A sum invested at \(8\%\) simple interest per annum amounts to Rs. \(4320\) in \(3\) years. What will be the amount after \(5\) years?
questions.keySolution:
Let \(P\) be the principal.  
\(P + 0.24P = 4320 \Rightarrow P = 4320/1.24 = 3483.87\).  
Amount after \(5\) years = \(P + 0.40P = 1.40P \approx 3483.87 \times 1.40 = 4880\) (rounded).

questions.stem: A certain sum amounts to Rs. \(7350\) in \(2\) years and Rs. \(8575\) in \(4\) years at simple interest. Find the rate percent per annum.
In how many years will Rs. \(3000\) amount to Rs. \(3993\) at \(11\%\) simple interest per annum?
A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs. \(2240\) in \(2\) years and Rs. \(2600\) in \(5\) years. What is the principal amount?
questions.keySolution:
Interest for \(3\) years = \(2600-2240 = 360\) ⇒ per year = \(120\).  
Principal = \(2240 - 120 \times 2 = 2000\).

questions.stem: The simple interest on Rs. \(6800\) at \(6.25\%\) per annum for a certain period is Rs. \(1700\). For what time was the money lent?
A sum becomes \(\frac{7}{5}\) of itself in \(3\) years at simple interest. In how many years will it become \(\frac{3}{2}\) of itself?
questions.keySolution:
Rate from first data = \(\frac{0.4 \times 100}{3} = 13.33\%\).  
Time to get SI = \(0.5P\): \(T = \frac{50 \times 3}{40} = 3.75\) years.

A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs. \(4745\) in \(3\) years and Rs. \(5475\) in \(5\) years. Find the principal.
questions.keySolution:
Interest for \(2\) years = \(5475-4745 = 730\) ⇒ per year = \(365\).  
Principal = \(4745 - 365 \times 3 = 3650\).

questions.stem: If Rs. \(1200\) amounts to Rs. \(1632\) in \(6\) years at simple interest, what will Rs. \(3000\) amount to in \(4\) years at the same rate?
questions.keySolution:
Rate from first data = \(6\%\).  
SI on \(3000\) for \(4\) years = \(3000 \times 6\% \times 4 = 720\).  
Amount = \(3000 + 720 = 3720\).

questions.stem: A certain sum at simple interest amounts to Rs. \(1386\) in \(3\) years and Rs. \(1764\) in \(7\) years. What is the rate percent per annum?
The simple interest on a sum for \(15\) years is \(\frac{3}{5}\) of the principal. What is the rate percent per annum?
A sum becomes Rs. \(1560\) in \(4\) years and Rs. \(1740\) in \(7\) years at simple interest. Find the principal amount.
questions.keySolution:
Interest for \(3\) years = \(1740-1560 = 180\) ⇒ per year = \(60\).  
SI for \(4\) years = \(60 \times 4 = 240\).  
Principal = \(1560 - 240 = 1320\).
